title: Smart clips
description: Cloud recommendations, editable drafts and local exports.
settingsHint: Use separate OpenAI-compatible endpoints for recommendations and timestamped transcription. Enter the API base URL including /v1 if required.
keySaved: Key saved; leave empty to retain
saveBeforeCheck: Save the service URL, model and key before checking the connection.
connectionHint: Reads the saved service's model list without sending subtitles or audio. The service must support model listing; charges depend on the provider.
connectionListed: The service responded and lists this model. Clip analysis and transcription capabilities remain unverified.
connectionNotListed: The service responded but does not list this model. Check its name; clip analysis and transcription capabilities remain unverified.
secureUnavailable: OS encryption is unavailable. Keys cannot be saved.
remoteHint: Remote recognition uploads audio and requires segment timestamps (verbose_json). Billing depends on your provider.
privacy: Clip analysis sends subtitles to your configured cloud service. Video rendering stays on this computer.
emptyCandidatesHint: Run cloud analysis, then select recommendations to create drafts.
emptyResult: No clips met your criteria. Adjust preferences or subtitles and try again.
noDrafts: Choose AI candidates to create a draft.
workingCopySaved: Local working copy saved; the draft has not been saved yet.
workingCopyUnavailable: Could not save the local working copy. Use Save draft.
workingCopyInvalid: Complete the current inputs. The last valid working copy is retained.
defaultsHint: Applies to newly created drafts. Existing drafts keep their settings. Uses the output resolution selected above.
oldTranscript: This result uses an earlier subtitle snapshot.
noSource: Choose a video in the Subtitles tab first.

errors.auth: Service authentication failed. Check the API key and access permissions.
errors.quota: The service quota or balance is insufficient. Check the account before retrying.
errors.rateLimit: The service is still rate limited. This request reached its retry limit; try again later.
errors.retryAfter: The service requires waiting {{seconds}} seconds before retrying.
errors.config: Configure the service URL and model first.
errors.secureStorage: Secure credential storage is unavailable. Unlock the OS keychain and retry.
errors.network: Cloud request failed. Check the endpoint and network.
errors.timeout: Cloud request timed out. Retry explicitly to avoid duplicate requests.
errors.http: Cloud service returned HTTP {{status}}. Check credentials, quota and rate limits.
errors.response: The service returned an invalid or oversized response.
errors.timestamps: The transcription service must return segments with reliable start/end timestamps (verbose_json).
errors.audioSize: Audio exceeds the supported upload size.
errors.captionTooLong: A subtitle exceeds the configured context limit. Edit it or increase the limit.
errors.invalidCandidates: The service returned no valid clip boundaries. Adjust preferences and retry.
errors.sourceChanged: The source is missing or has changed. Re-import the media.
errors.conflict: The draft changed. Reload it or save the working copy as another version.
errors.candidate: Choose candidates from the same subtitle snapshot.
errors.busy: Wait for the current operation or cancel it first.
errors.notFound: The requested clip, draft or output no longer exists.
errors.range: Scene boundaries exceed the source or total duration limit.
errors.empty: Select at least one candidate before rendering.
errors.videoOnly: Smart clipping requires a video source.
errors.interrupted: The application stopped before this task completed. Retry to continue.
errors.output: Choose a new output file; source media and existing files cannot be overwritten.
errors.coverFrame: Could not read the cover frame. Try another frame time.
errors.coverText: The cover text is too long. Shorten the title or subtitle.
errors.coverRange: Choose a cover frame inside one of the draft's scenes.
errors.coverSidecar: The cover was generated but could not be saved beside the video. Export its JPEG separately.
errors.coverCanvas: The system could not create a cover canvas of this size. Try another aspect ratio.
